SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity),0) AS value FROM pos_return_lines s JOIN pos_returns r ON r.id=s.return_id WHERE r.store_id=$1 AND r.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
SELECT s.business_date,SUM(s.net_paise) AS net,SUM(s.restock_cost_paise) AS cost FROM pos_returns s  WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 GROUP BY s.business_date
SELECT s.snapshot FROM pos_returns s  WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS documents,COALESCE(SUM(s.net_paise),0) AS net,COALESCE(SUM(s.tax_paise),0) AS gst,COALESCE(SUM(s.total_paise),0) AS gross,COALESCE(SUM(s.restock_cost_paise),0) AS restock,COALESCE(SUM(s.discard_cost_paise),0) AS discard FROM pos_returns s  WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_paise),0) AS value FROM pos_returns s JOIN pos_sales sale ON sale.id=s.sale_id WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 AND sale.customer_id=$4

pos_reports_analytics_aggregate_pos_sale.sql: SELECT s.product_id,SUM(s.quantity) AS units,SUM(s.net_paise) AS net,SUM(s.quantity*s.cost_paise) AS cost,SUM(s.regular_paise-s.paid_paise) AS discounts FROM pos_sale_lines s JOIN pos_sales sale ON sale.id=s.sale_id WHERE sale.store_id=$1 AND sale.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 GROUP BY s.product_id

SELECT s.gst_bps,SUM(s.net_paise) AS taxable_paise,SUM(s.cgst_paise) AS cgst_paise,SUM(s.sgst_paise) AS sgst_paise,SUM(s.igst_paise) AS igst_paise FROM pos_sale_lines s JOIN pos_sales sale ON sale.id=s.sale_id WHERE sale.store_id=$1 AND sale.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 GROUP BY s.gst_bps
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity),0) AS value FROM pos_sale_lines s JOIN pos_sales sale ON sale.id=s.sale_id WHERE sale.store_id=$1 AND sale.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3

SELECT s.kind,COUNT(DISTINCT s.sale_id) AS transactions,SUM(s.saving_paise) AS saving_paise FROM pos_sale_offers s JOIN pos_sales sale ON sale.id=s.sale_id WHERE sale.store_id=$1 AND sale.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 GROUP BY s.kind
SELECT s.business_date,COUNT(*) AS n,SUM(s.subtotal_paise) AS net,SUM(s.cogs_paise) AS cost FROM pos_sales s  WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 GROUP BY s.business_date
SELECT s.snapshot,s.created FROM pos_sales s  WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions,COALESCE(SUM(s.subtotal_paise),0) AS revenue,COALESCE(SUM(s.total_paise),0) AS collected,COALESCE(SUM(s.tax_paise),0) AS gst,COALESCE(SUM(s.discount_paise),0) AS discounts,COALESCE(SUM(s.cogs_paise),0) AS cost,COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers FROM pos_sales s  WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3

SELECT c.id,c.name,c.phone,COUNT(*) AS visits,SUM(s.total_paise) AS spent_paise FROM pos_sales s JOIN pos_customers c ON c.id=s.customer_id WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 GROUP BY c.id,c.name,c.phone ORDER BY spent_paise DESC LIMIT 20

pos_reports_analytics_aggregate_pos_shif.sql: SELECT s.id,s.register_id,st.name AS cashier,s.business_date,s.opened,s.closed,s.counted_paise,s.expected_paise,s.variance_paise FROM pos_shifts s JOIN pos_staff st ON st.id=s.staff_id WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND s.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 ORDER BY s.opened DESC LIMIT 100

pos_api_search_sales.sql: SELECT s.id,s.number,s.business_date,s.created,s.total_paise,s.subtotal_paise,s.tax_paise,customer.name AS customer_name,(SELECT st.name FROM pos_staff st WHERE st.id=s.staff_id AND st.store_id=s.store_id) AS cashier,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.total_paise) FROM pos_returns r WHERE r.sale_id=s.id AND r.store_id=s.store_id),0) AS refunded_paise FROM pos_sales s LEFT JOIN pos_customers customer ON customer.id=s.customer_id AND customer.store_id=s.store_id WHERE s.store_id=$1 AND ($2='' OR s.business_date>=$2) AND ($3='' OR s.business_date<=$3) AND ($4='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',s.number,s.id,customer.name,customer.phone)),lower($4))>0) ORDER BY s.created DESC,s.id LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6
